title: Query Complexity and Achievable Functions in Multivariable Quantum Signal Processing
exact_target: Find query lower bounds under the allowed extra resources, and identify a simple numerically useful subclass of achievable multivariable functions.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006092 (OWR-14298801-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
